definitions.explanation: The position at the back of someone or something; the opposite of the front.

examples.japanese: {後|うし}ろを{見|み}てください。
{彼|かれ}は{私|わたし}の{後|うし}ろにいます。
{後|うし}ろの{席|せき}に{座|すわ}ります。
examples.english: I'll sit in the back seat.

examples.japanese: {車|くるま}の{後|うし}ろに{自転車|じてんしゃ}がありました。
examples.english: There was a bicycle behind the car.

examples.japanese: {後|うし}ろから{誰|だれ}かに{名前|なまえ}を{呼|よ}ばれました。
examples.english: Someone called my name from behind.

notes:
{後|うし}ろ indicates position at the back or rear of something. The opposite is {前|まえ} (mae, front). Common pattern: 〜の{後|うし}ろに (behind ~).

Note: Different from {後|あと} (ato), which means 'after' in time.
